title: WISER 4000 Brochure
description: Eight-page brochure on the WISER 4000 wireless strain system, covering the remote unit, base unit, Data Viewer software, kit contents, application examples, and shaft enclosures.

title: WISER 4000 Brochure (German)
description: Four-page German-language brochure describing the WISER 4000 system, its three subsystems, and its benefits.

title: WISER 8000 Brochure
description: Eight-page brochure on the WISER 8000 dual-channel strain system, with a comparison to the WISER 4000, electronics specifications, applications, and accessories.

title: TC2-K Data Sheet
description: Two-page data sheet for the TECAT TC2-K wireless temperature system, which reads two K-type thermocouples and was designed for brake rotor measurements. Published under the earlier WISER name.

title: OEM Telemetry Platform Brochure
description: Brochure in spread layout describing TECAT's wireless OEM telemetry platform for integration into OEM products, including a pump jack load cell example. Published under the earlier WISER name.

title: LC100-PP Pre-Production Brochure
description: Four-page pre-production brochure with specifications for the TECAT LC100-PP telemetry system, designed for artificial lift load cell applications. Published under the earlier WISER name.

title: Remote Enclosures Data Sheet
description: One-page data sheet for the TECAT remote enclosures, listing shaft diameter ranges, heights, operating temperature, and maximum RPM by mounting method. Published under the earlier WISER name.

title: Brake Rotor Temperature Measurements
description: Application note on measuring brake rotor temperature inside a wheel hub with a wireless system that uses two K-type thermocouples.

title: Drive Shaft Measurement for Shift Harshness Evaluation
description: Application note on measuring driveshaft torque on test vehicles during long road trips to evaluate transmission shift harshness.

title: Flex Plate Measurements
description: Application note on a custom TECAT system packaged on a flex plate to measure torque between the engine and transmission.

title: Half Shaft Monitoring
description: Application note on measuring wheel torque on vehicle half shafts during hard launches to compare stock and aftermarket parts.

title: Torque/Turn Measurements
description: Application note on a load cell based TECAT system that measures torque and turns on the hydraulic chain tongs used on drilling rigs.

title: U-Joint Monitoring
description: Application note on monitoring torque and temperature on U-joints in truck fleets to find the cause of field failures.

title: Case Study: Pigging for Pipe Anomalies
description: Case study on a small pipeline pig carrying an inclinometer, accelerometer, and magnetometer to locate buried valves along a six-mile line.

title: TECAT Announces Licensure Agreement for Wireless Axial Load Cell Electronics Capability
description: TECAT licensed its wireless load cell electronics, which combine position data with load for artificial lift, to Flintec for the CC1W load cell.

title: TECAT Announces Patent for Wireless Axial Load Cell and Sensor Assembly Capability
description: TECAT announced a patent for its wireless axial load cell and sensor assembly, the WISER LC100, which combines position data with load for artificial lift.

title: TECAT Now Shipping WISER 8000 Wireless Strain Measuring and Monitoring System
description: TECAT began shipping the WISER 8000, a dual-channel wireless strain system with data rates up to 8 kHz and a transmission range over 1,000 meters.

title: TECAT Signs Representative Agreement with Barnstorm Aviation Solutions, LLC
description: TECAT signed a sales representative agreement with Barnstorm Aviation Solutions to reach home-built and experimental aircraft builders.

title: TECAT Expands U.S. Rep Network to Rocky Mountain States
description: TECAT signed Technologies West RMS as its manufacturers' representative for Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, New Mexico, Utah, and Wyoming.

title: TECAT Expands U.S. Rep Network to Mid-Atlantic, California, and Nevada
description: TECAT signed Measurements Inc. for the mid-Atlantic states and Sentech Measurements Inc. for California and Nevada as manufacturers' representatives.

title: TECAT to Demonstrate WISER 4000 for Petroleum Industry at 2016 PBIOS
description: TECAT announced live demonstrations of the WISER 4000, including torque/turn monitoring for drilling rigs, at the 2016 Permian Basin International Oil Show in Odessa, Texas.

title: TECAT Introduces New Wireless Temperature Measurement and Monitoring System for Automotive Brake Rotors
description: TECAT introduced the WISER TC2-K, a wireless temperature system for automotive brake rotors designed to mount inside wheel hubs.

title: TECAT Now Shipping WISER 4000 Wireless Torque Measuring and Monitoring System
description: TECAT began shipping the WISER 4000, which adds shunt calibration, two more programmable analog outputs, and faster recording.

title: TECAT to Demonstrate WISER 4000 in Automotive Applications at Sensors Expo & Conference 2016
description: TECAT announced live demonstrations of the WISER 4000 in automotive applications at Sensors Expo & Conference 2016 in San Jose, California.

title: TECAT to Debut Next-Generation Wireless Motion Sensor System at Automotive Testing Expo Europe 2016
description: TECAT announced the debut of its next-generation WISER system, with shunt calibration and two added programmable analog outputs, at Automotive Testing Expo Europe 2016 in Stuttgart.

title: TECAT Introduces Custom Enclosures for WISER 2030-S Remote Unit and Battery
description: TECAT introduced optional enclosures that protect the WISER 2030-S remote unit and battery and attach to shafts with hose clamps.

title: TECAT Announces First Wireless Torque Sensor Model Featuring Shunt Calibration
description: TECAT released the WISER 2030-S, its first wireless torque sensor model with shunt calibration.

title: TECAT Sponsors Baja SAE and Formula SAE Intercollegiate Design Competitions
description: TECAT became an equipment supplier sponsor of the Baja SAE and Formula SAE collegiate competitions, offering teams torque measurement for half shafts and drive shafts.

title: TECAT to Showcase WISER Model 2030 at the Advanced Automotive Diagnostics Systems Summit
description: TECAT announced demonstrations of the WISER 2030 monitoring flex plate strain and U-joint temperature and vibration at the Advanced Automotive Diagnostics Systems Summit in Stuttgart.

title: TECAT Announces Launch of the WISER 2030 Torque Telemetry System
description: TECAT launched the WISER 2030 torque telemetry system, which adds on-board high-speed data logging with triggering and remote firmware updates.

title: TECAT Signs Sales Representative Agreement with Stress Analysis Services
description: TECAT signed a sales representative agreement with Stress Analysis Services.
